title: Violation
description: One finding of one rule: what is wrong, cited by the rule's id, and where it is reported. The anchor is a line inside the surface, the dead line where the surface made code dead, or the pull request as a whole where no single line is to blame. The body states what is wrong, not how to fix it

examples.body: [No suppressed exit status](https://thruput.se/agents/#no-suppressed-exit-status): the pipeline's exit status is discarded, so a failing check passes as success.

rule.description: The rule violated, by its id

body.description: What is wrong, briefly, citing the rule by id as a link to its anchor on the published rules

Side.description: RIGHT for a line of the file at the head commit, LEFT for a line removed from the base

Line.description: One line of one file, numbered in the file on the side named, never as a diff hunk offset

Lines.description: Consecutive lines of one file on one side

PullRequest.description: The pull request as a whole: an existing component that replaces a whole module, or a standard the change set as a whole does not follow. Carried in the review body rather than on a line
